NEW to Colleen Rothschild

THE RETREAT Body Cream is more than a moisturizer - it’s daily care for the skin below your chin. Just like your face, your body is prone to dehydration, fine lines, uneven tone, and rough texture, and deserves the same level of care.

This intensely nourishing cream is powered by barrier-replenishing ceramides, moisture-locking shea butter, and a botanical blend of antioxidant-rich plant oils and extracts.

Infused with an enveloping blend of warm vanilla, golden caramel, amber, and soft patchouli, the signature scent wraps the senses in comforting warmth and tranquility - indulgent yet beautifully understated.

210 g (7.4 fl oz)
